title: Prompt Surrender Timing Credit (Repossession and Collateral Recovery)
content:
Borrower terms for surrendering a vehicle promptly once a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case has been opened.

**Rule.** Where the vehicle came in no more than 3 calendar days after the case's opened date, a surrender timing credit of 30.00 applies; where it came in more than 3 but no more than 7 calendar days after the opened date, a surrender timing credit of 15.00 applies; where it came in later, no surrender timing credit applies.

The opened date is the referral date of the case; the day the vehicle came in is the recovery date on the case.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical case opened on 1 March)

| Vehicle came in | Days after the opened date | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 4 March | 3 | 30.00 |
| 5 March | 4 | 15.00 |
| 8 March | 7 | 15.00 |
| 9 March | 8 | none |

A vehicle that came in on the opened date itself is 0 days after it and falls in the first band.
